name: vphone-cli
stdout:
OVERVIEW: Boot a virtual iPhone or patch firmware with the Swift pipeline

USAGE: vphone-cli <subcommand>

OPTIONS:
  -h, --help              Show help information.

SUBCOMMANDS:
  boot (default)          Boot a virtual iPhone (PV=3)
  patch-firmware          Patch boot-chain firmware in a VM directory using the
                          Swift pipeline (diagnostic entry: takes a bare path
                          instead of a VM name; `vphone-cli fw patch` is the
                          normal one). Both take the same VM-directory lock and
                          refuse a busy VM.
  patch-component         Patch a single firmware component payload and write
                          the patched raw bytes
  vm                      Manage vphone VM bundles
  fw                      Firmware pipeline: prepare (download/merge IPSWs) and
                          patch
  restore                 DFU-restore firmware into a VM bundle (requires a
                          running DFU boot)
  cfw                     Custom-firmware install (host-mount; VM must be off;
                          re-execs sudo)
  setup                   Provision/verify the host Python environment
                          (~/.vphone/venv)
  resources               Print the resolved runtime resource directory
  doctor                  Diagnose the host and a VM without changing anything
                          (read-only)
  sign                    Sign an ARM Mach-O with the native signing library
  dump-entitlements       Print a Mach-O's embedded entitlements (replaces
                          `ldid -e`)
  archive                 Unpack and pack archives
  restore-inspect         Inspect a local restore directory and optional ticket
                          without accessing a device
  core-bundle             Install and verify root-owned Core Bundles
  helper                  Manage the signed privileged helper (requires a
                          configured Apple signing team)
  guest                   Send host-control requests to a running VM

  See 'vphone-cli help <subcommand>' for detailed help.
